parametric_acceleration_model.formula_latex: M(v) = \begin{cases} 1.0, & v \le \alpha \\ 1.0 + \frac{u \cdot ((\alpha - 1.0) + |\beta| \cdot u)}{1.0 + \gamma \cdot u}, & v > \alpha, \ u = v - \alpha \end{cases}
parametric_acceleration_model.description: Rational parametric acceleration curve evaluating continuous scroll gain from input velocity

low_speed.behavior: High-precision micro-positioning with minimal acceleration gain

medium_speed.behavior: Progressive non-linear acceleration scaling with gesture velocity

high_speed.behavior: Rapid ballistic flinging asymptotically saturating near maximum clamp

trackpad_momentum_kinetics.continuous_decay_latex: v(t) = v_0 \cdot e^{-\lambda t}, \quad \lambda = -\frac{\ln(0.950)}{\Delta t} \approx 5.1293 \text{ s}^{-1}

interruption_protocol.action: Immediate timer invalidation via dispatch_source_set_timer(DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER), zeroing residual momentum, resetting multiplier to 1.0
